_doc: Per-species extraction fixes, applied by tools/petart/extract.py and copied into PROVENANCE.md. cells: keys 's<stage>/<bNN|cNN>' or '*/<bNN|cNN>' with any of source (render this file from another cell of the same stage), flip (mirror horizontally), dx/dy (canvas px nudge; dy<0 raises), fit_exclude (shrink only this cell if it would not fit), why (required). sheets: keys 's<stage>/<base|care>' with scale (relative size multiplier for every cell of that sheet, used when the generator drew one sheet of a stage at a different character size than the other), why (required).

s2/care.why: The stage-2 care sheet draws the penguin about 1.28x larger than its base sheet (standing heights of b00 vs upright care poses); normalised so care frames match the idle size.

s3/care.why: The stage-3 care sheet draws the penguin about 1.25x larger than its base sheet; normalised to the idle size.

s2/care.why: The stage-2 care sheet draws the robot about 0.8x the size of its base sheet (b00 vs c10 standing heights to the antenna tip); normalised to the idle size.

s3/care.why: The stage-3 care sheet draws the robot about 0.79x the size of its base sheet; normalised to the idle size.

s1/care.why: The stage-1 care sheet draws the pup about 0.76x the size of its base sheet (b02 vs c07 standing heights); normalised to the idle size.
